title: Additional fees.
officialText:
Additional fees for licensing shall be set forth in the rules of the department. Additional fees include, but are not limited to, reissuance, deactivation, reactivation and late renewal.

(L.L. 2021/126, 11/7/2021, eff. 11/7/2022)
